result:
Applied the upstream fix for click's fish shell completion regression. Summary of changes:

- **`src/click/shell_completion.py`**: Reworked `FishComplete.format_completion` to go back to the pre-8.4.0, single-line `type,value\thelp` format (matching fish's documented `complete` convention of newline-separated arguments with a tab-separated description) instead of the broken 3-line `type\nvalue\nhelp` scheme from #3126, which corrupted the fish script's line-based parsing for any completion list with more than one item. Newlines in help text are escaped to `\n` and tabs replaced with spaces so multi-line help still renders on one line. Simplified the fish script itself (`_SOURCE_FISH`) to split on `,` instead of re-splitting on already-consumed newlines.
- **`tests/test_shell_completion.py`**: Updated expected output for the format change, removed the now-obsolete `test_fish_multiline_help_complete` test (which only "passed" by coincidence with a single item), and added `test_fish_format_completion_escapes_help` verifying newline/tab escaping directly.
- **`CHANGES.rst`**: Added the changelog entry for 8.4.2 referencing the original regression and issues #3502/#3043.

All 54 tests in `test_shell_completion.py` pass; the full suite's remaining failures are pre-existing/unrelated (deprecation warnings, environment issues) and untouched by this change.
